gaps.title: Accuracy language lacks an explicit evidence and error decomposition
gaps.researchable_question: Can one declared quantity-of-interest ledger separate model, numerical, sampling, data, mapping, and hardware error?

gaps.title: Cross-scale and cross-platform simulation claims lack comparable baselines
gaps.researchable_question: Can a common model-card protocol decide when a classical method is preferable, a quantum method is a candidate, or the evidence is insufficient?

gaps.title: Quantum computing is necessary for all microscopic accuracy
gaps.researchable_question: Rejected: the claim has no evidence basis and ignores classical microscopic methods and hardware/mapping limits.
